items.imgPrompt: Thick black legal reference books with crisp pages, on a cluttered wooden study desk beside folders, slight shelf dust, no visible text or logos

desc.zh: 事務所已經有一套，這套只是重複輸入。內容沒有問題，別因為封面沾了點灰就壓價。
desc.zh_cn: 事务所已经有一套，这套只是重复输入。内容没有问题，别因为封面沾了点灰就压价。
desc.en: The office already had a set. This is merely redundant input. The contents are fine, so do not haggle over a little dust.

items.imgPrompt: Natural wood acoustic guitar with faded blue strap, resting beside a sofa in a modest apartment, minor scratches and dusty strings, no logo

name.zh: 放棄得很徹底的木吉他
name.zh_cn: 放弃得很彻底的木吉他

desc.zh: 曾經試圖培養一項與法律無關的興趣。弦按不出聲不是吉他的錯，大概也不是我的——總之賣掉。
desc.zh_cn: 曾经试图培养一项与法律无关的兴趣。弦按不出声不是吉他的错，大概也不是我的——总之卖掉。
desc.en: I once attempted to cultivate an interest unrelated to law. The strings may be innocent, and so may I. Either way, it is for sale.

items.imgPrompt: Unlit cream scented candle in a plain glass jar, on a gray apartment windowsill, barely used wax, small dust marks, no label or text

name.zh: 不適合審訊室氣氛的香氛蠟燭
name.zh_cn: 不适合审讯室气氛的香氛蜡烛

desc.zh: 別人送的。香味過於甜膩，點著之後連思考都像被收買了。只用過一次，喜歡的人請帶走。
desc.zh_cn: 别人送的。香味过于甜腻，点着之后连思考都像被收买了。只用过一次，喜欢的人请带走。
desc.en: A gift from someone else. The sweetness is excessive; after lighting it, even thinking feels bribed. Used once. Someone else can take it.

items.imgPrompt: Dark gray cotton bathrobe folded on a white bathroom shelf, slightly faded cuffs and faint water marks, ordinary compact apartment bathroom, no text

name.zh: 穿著泡澡實驗後留下的浴袍
name.zh_cn: 穿着泡澡实验后留下的浴袍

desc.zh: 我只是想確認穿著衣服泡澡究竟有沒有意義。結論是沒有，浴袍倒是還能穿。不要追問細節。
desc.zh_cn: 我只是想确认穿着衣服泡澡究竟有没有意义。结论是没有，浴袍倒是还能穿。不要追问细节。
desc.en: I merely wanted to determine whether bathing fully dressed had any meaning. It does not. The robe remains wearable. Do not ask for details.

items.imgPrompt: Compact stainless steel coffee maker with scratched black handle, on a narrow kitchen counter beside an unused mug, mild limescale, no logo

desc.zh: 看了三分鐘評測就買了，後來發現咖啡還是會自己變苦。功能都正常，價格已經按使用痕跡調整。
desc.zh_cn: 看了三分钟评测就买了，后来发现咖啡还是会自己变苦。功能都正常，价格已经按使用痕迹调整。
desc.en: I bought it after watching three minutes of reviews, then discovered coffee still becomes bitter by itself. It works. The price reflects the wear.
